name: daily-secrets-scan
description: Daily repository secrets scan — checks for accidentally committed API keys, tokens, and credentials.
prompt: Scan all files modified in the last 24 hours for hardcoded secrets: Stripe keys (sk_live_, sk_test_), JWT secrets, database connection strings with passwords, Auth0 client secrets, .env contents. Also run a scan of the last 10 commits. Report any findings immediately — SECURITY CRITICAL.
